originalWasmMetadata: Original silk-wasm 3.7.1 decoded hashes remain in the original JSON sidecars for provenance. Its decoder wrapper does not update nBytesPerPacket[MAX_LBRR_DELAY] after reading new packets, so after the first two packets its PCM differs from the upstream SDK. Native decoding must match the unchanged upstream SDK, not that wrapper behavior.
